cards.ex: Her mental agility allowed her to quickly adapt to the changing market conditions.
cards.exUz: Uning aqliy chaqqonligi unga bozordagi o'zgaruvchan sharoitlarga tez moslashishga imkon berdi.
cards.uzDef: Tez fikrlash va muammolarni oson hal qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The project required significant intellectual horsepower to succeed.
cards.exUz: Loyihaning muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi uchun katta intellektual quvvat talab qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Katta aqliy qobiliyat, juda kuchli fikrlash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The company's lack of foresight led to its downfall.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning uzoqni ko'ra olmasligi uning qulashiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakni oldindan ko'ra olmaslik, oqibatlarni hisobga olmaslik.

cards.ex: Understanding the problem is half the battle; now we need to solve it.
cards.exUz: Muammoni tushunish - yarim g'alaba; endi uni hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy qismi bajarilgan, muvaffaqiyatning muhim qismi.

cards.ex: He's a nice guy, but he's not exactly the brightest crayon in the box.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi yigit, lekin u qutidagi eng yorqin bo'yoq emas.
cards.uzDef: Aqli zaif, unchalik aqlli emasligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: Sending him to find the missing file is a fool's errand; he'll never find it.
cards.exUz: Uni yo'qolgan faylni topishga yuborish ahmoqona ish; u hech qachon uni topa olmaydi.

cards.ex: The country is suffering from a brain drain as talented graduates seek opportunities abroad.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat iste'dodli bitiruvchilar xorijda imkoniyatlar izlayotgani sababli aqlning ketishidan aziyat chekmoqda.

cards.ex: I've got a mental block and can't seem to finish this report.
cards.exUz: Menda aqliy to'siq bor va men bu hisobotni tugata olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qila olmaslik, ijodiy fikrlay olmaslik.

cards.ex: His inane remarks during the meeting were completely unhelpful.
cards.exUz: Uning yig'ilishdagi ma'nisiz gaplari mutlaqo foydasiz edi.

cards.ex: Her lack of judgment led her to make a very poor investment.
cards.exUz: Uning hukmning yo'qligi uni juda yomon sarmoya kiritishga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri qaror qabul qila olmaslik, noto'g'ri baho berish.

cards.ex: She's really on the ball; she anticipated all the potential problems.
cards.exUz: U juda epchil; u barcha mumkin bo'lgan muammolarni oldindan ko'ra oldi.
cards.uzDef: Tezkor, diqqatli va o'z vazifasini yaxshi bajaradigan.

cards.ex: The lecture was intellectually stimulating and made me question my assumptions.
cards.exUz: Ma'ruza aqlga rag'batlantiruvchi edi va meni o'z taxminlarimni so'roq qilishga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga, fikrlashga undaydigan, aql uchun foydali.

cards.ex: He had a flash of inspiration and suddenly knew how to solve the problem.
cards.exUz: Unga ilhom keldi va u muammoni qanday hal qilishni birdaniga bildi.

cards.ex: He's a complete dullard; I can't believe he got the job.
cards.exUz: U butunlay aqli past; u ishni qanday olganiga ishonolmayman.

cards.ex: He presented a crackpot theory about aliens controlling the government.
cards.exUz: U hukumatni o'zga sayyoraliklar boshqarishi haqida ahmoqona nazariyani taqdim etdi.

cards.ex: Don't second-guess yourself; you made the right decision.
cards.exUz: O'zingizga shubha qilmang; siz to'g'ri qaror qabul qildingiz.

cards.ex: He learned the poem by rote, but he didn't understand its meaning.
cards.exUz: U she'rni yodlab o'rgandi, lekin uning ma'nosini tushunmadi.

cards.ex: It's a common fallacy that wealth equals happiness.
cards.exUz: Boylik baxtga teng ekanligi - umumiy xato.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilik tomonidan qabul qilingan noto'g'ri fikr.

cards.ex: Mixing those chemicals is a recipe for disaster; they could explode.
cards.exUz: Bu kimyoviy moddalarni aralashtirish - falokat retsepti; ular portlashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyat, noto'g'ri harakatlar natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo'lgan falokat.

cards.ex: He has a blind spot when it comes to his own children's faults.
cards.exUz: Uning o'z farzandlarining xatolariga kelganda ko'rmas nuqtasi bor.

cards.ex: She's a bit featherbrained, but she's got a good heart.
cards.exUz: U biroz yengiltak, lekin uning yuragi yaxshi.

cards.ex: You must have taken leave of your senses to agree to that!
cards.exUz: Bunga rozi bo'lish uchun siz aqlini yo'qotgan bo'lishingiz kerak!
cards.uzDef: O'zini tuta olmaslik, aql bilan ish qilmaslik.

cards.ex: Her intellectual prowess was evident in her groundbreaking research.
cards.exUz: Uning aqliy mahorati uning innovatsion tadqiqotlarida yaqqol namoyon bo'ldi.

cards.ex: He's such a simpleton; he believes everything he reads online.
cards.exUz: U juda sodda; u onlaynda o'qigan hamma narsasiga ishonadi.

cards.ex: He tried to pull the wool over my eyes, but I saw right through his lies.
cards.exUz: U meni aldamoqchi bo'ldi, lekin men uning yolg'onlarini payqadim.

cards.ex: I was at a loss for words when I heard the news.
cards.exUz: Men yangilikni eshitganimda nima deyishni bilmay qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Hayratdan yoki chalkashlikdan nima deyishni bilmaslik.

cards.ex: Without any hard data, all we can offer is an educated guess.
cards.exUz: Hech qanday aniq ma'lumotlarsiz, biz faqat ilmiy taxminni taklif qila olamiz.

cards.ex: Don't fall for those scams; they're designed to trick you.
cards.exUz: Bu firibgarliklarga aldanib qolmang; ular sizni aldash uchun mo'ljallangan.

cards.ex: You've been quiet all evening. A penny for your thoughts?
cards.exUz: Siz butun oqshom jim bo'ldingiz. Nima o'ylayapsan?

cards.ex: It was a stroke of genius to combine those two ideas.
cards.exUz: Bu ikki g'oyani birlashtirish daho zarbasi edi.
